      properties:

          title: Title

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp

          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          title: Schema validation errors

          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'

        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

## Summary

Added a `bulkSignupWarning` flag to owner creation: `true` when more than 80 owners already share the new owner's registration date at creation time, else `false`. It mirrors the existing `RejectOverDailyLimit`/`CountOwnerNamesakes` pattern — compute during the POST pipeline, persist on the entity, surface via the mapper.

Changes:
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema (generates the field/setter on `OwnerDto`).
- **`Owner.java`** — new `Boolean bulkSignupWarning` field mapped to a `bulk_signup_warning` column, with getter/setter.
- **Schema SQL** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `bulk_signup_warning` column.
- **`FlagBulkSignup.java`** — new OfficeFloor step; counts existing owners sharing the new owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date and sets the flag when `> 80`. Runs before `SaveOwner`, so the new owner isn't counted — the same accumulation path as the daily-limit rule, one threshold lower.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired `flagBulkSignup` into the pipeline between `countNamesakes` and `save`, under the `transaction` governance.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — maps `bulkSignupWarning` via a null-safe expression (`Boolean.TRUE.equals(...)`), so seed/legacy rows without the flag render as `false` rather than NPE-ing.

The acceptance test (`coreNoBulkWarningUnderThreshold`) and the full suite pass. The `>80` branch rides the same counting path the daily-limit rule already exercises.

Note: this is not a git repository, so there's nothing to commit.
